heroSummary: Memphis-Shelby County Schools began the 2025–26 school year Monday, August 4, 2025, and the last day for students was Thursday, May 21, 2026. Fall Break was October 13–17, Thanksgiving Break November 24–28, Winter Break December 22–January 5, and Spring Break March 16–20. MSCS also scheduled Spring Break II for April 3–6.

calendarFaqs.q: When did MSCS start school in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for students was Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MSCS Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break ran October 13–17, 2025. Students returned Monday, October 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MSCS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 5, 2026. Students returned Tuesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When was MSCS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The main Spring Break ran March 16–20, 2026. Spring Break II ran April 3–6.

calendarFaqs.q: Were MSCS parent-conference dates no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The Student Calendar listed separate high, middle and elementary conference evenings from 4–7 p.m. without marking them as student holidays.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of MSCS in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students was Thursday, May 21, 2026.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 20, 2026 against the final official MSCS 2025–26 Student Calendar.
sourceReviewDetails: The one-page PDF was checked as embedded text and as a full-page visual against the user-provided local source copy.
August 4, May 21, every published student-out period, six 4–7 p.m. conference evenings and the semester-exam ranges were checked.
The calendar lists 87 first-semester days and 88 second-semester days, for 175 total student days.
Spring Break II is preserved as a separate April 3–6 period rather than merged into the main March Spring Break.
sourceMaintainerText: Memphis-Shelby County Schools; calendar data reviewed by MySchoolDates against the final MSCS publication.
